settings.heading: I've tried probiotics. How is this different?
settings.content:
It's the question we hear most. Probiotics add more bacteria to your gut. That helps some people, but if unwanted bacteria are already hiding behind a protective layer, adding more on top doesn't reach them.

Veltia works on that layer instead. Garlic helps break it down,* so oregano, wormwood and black walnut can reach what's behind it.*

settings.heading: It worked for a while, then came back. Why would this be different?
settings.content:
You're not alone. Most people who find us have a story like that.

One common reason: bacteria tucked under a protective layer called biofilm can wait out a treatment, then grow back. Lab studies show garlic can help break that layer down,* which is why it leads our formula.

Veltia is a supplement, not medical care. If your symptoms are new, severe or getting worse, please see your doctor.

settings.heading: My main problem is bloating after meals. Can this help?
settings.content:
That's exactly who we made it for.

When unwanted bacteria build up, they ferment your food and make gas. That's the tight, uncomfortable bloat that creeps in a few hours after you eat. Veltia is designed to help clear that buildup, for less bloating and gas over time.*

settings.heading: How long should I take it?
settings.content:
Plan on at least 90 days of daily use. The buildup didn't happen overnight, and it won't clear overnight either. It's also why our guarantee runs the full 90 days.

Want to keep going after that? Check in with your doctor first.

settings.heading: Why drops and not capsules?
settings.content:
Two reasons. Drops let you start small: garlic, oregano and wormwood are strong herbs, so we suggest a few drops at first and working up to a full dropper.

And there's nothing to swallow. Most people stir it into a little water or juice.

settings.heading: What does it taste like?
settings.content:
Honestly? Earthy and bitter. Wormwood is one of the most bitter herbs there is, and it tastes like what it is.

Most people stir it into a small glass of water or juice and drink it quickly. A sip of plain water after helps.

settings.heading: Is there a guarantee?
settings.content: Yes, a full 90 days. Take it daily, give it a real chance, and if you don't feel a difference, email us and we'll refund your order in full.

settings.heading: I've tried oregano oil before. Why would this work?
settings.content:
Oregano is good at what's out in the open. On its own, it has a hard time getting past the layer bacteria build around themselves.

So we didn't build Veltia around one herb. Garlic goes first to help open that layer up,* then oregano, wormwood and black walnut get to work on what's underneath.*

settings.heading: Why garlic? Can't I just eat more garlic?
settings.content:
We wish it were that easy. Garlic's useful compound, allicin, only forms when garlic is crushed, and it fades fast. Cooking destroys most of it.

Every serving of Veltia has at least 10 mg of stabilized allicin, made to stay strong in the bottle. That's hard to get reliably from your kitchen.

settings.heading: The Reason Your Bloating Keeps Coming Back
settings.heading_highlight: Is Not What You Were Told
settings.body:
You've probably been told it's stress, or something you ate. Sometimes it is. But when bloating keeps coming back no matter what you change, there's often something else going on.

Bacteria in the gut can build a slimy protective layer around themselves called biofilm. Under that shield, they're hard to reach. That's why the usual fixes tend to fade:

  • Diets starve the bacteria for a while. They don't remove them.
  • Probiotics add more bacteria on top.
  • Single herbs mostly reach what's out in the open.

What's under the shield waits it out, then grows back. And so does the bloating.

settings.heading: Break the shield. Clear what's behind it.
settings.body:
You didn't do anything wrong. Nothing you tried was built to get past the shield.

Veltia starts with garlic, at least 10 mg of stabilized allicin per serving, to help loosen that layer.* Oregano, wormwood and black walnut then go to work on what was hiding underneath.* Pau d'arco, pumpkin seed and soursop round it out with traditional support for a balanced gut.*

settings.title: I used to have two wardrobes.
settings.body:
I used to have two wardrobes. My normal clothes and my 'bloated clothes.' By dinner my stomach would be so swollen I looked six months pregnant. I tried changing everything I ate. Nothing seemed to stick.

After a few weeks with these drops, I started noticing more comfortable evenings. Being able to put on jeans after dinner without immediately unbuttoning them felt like such a small thing, but to me it was everything.
settings.author: Jessica M., 38

settings.title: I went out to dinner and actually enjoyed myself.
settings.body:
I got to the point where I was scared to eat before going anywhere. Even something small could leave me feeling bloated and uncomfortable for hours. I'd skip lunch if I had dinner plans. That's how bad it got.

I didn't expect much when I started these drops, but over time my stomach started feeling more settled. Last weekend I went out to dinner and actually enjoyed myself instead of worrying about how I'd feel afterward.
settings.author: Rachel T., 42

settings.title: Digestion wasn't the first thing on my mind.
settings.body:
Probiotics, elimination diets, digestive enzymes. I had a whole cabinet of things that were supposed to help my stomach. Every time I'd get my hopes up, I'd end up right back where I started. I was honestly skeptical about trying one more thing.

What surprised me was how much less I found myself thinking about my stomach throughout the day. I finally started having days where digestion wasn't the first thing on my mind.
settings.author: Michelle D., 45

settings.title: That meant more to me than I can explain.
settings.body:
Nobody understood why I kept canceling plans. It wasn't that I didn't want to go. I just never knew when my stomach was going to act up. I'd spend entire evenings uncomfortable, wishing I had stayed home.

Since adding these drops to my routine, I've noticed a difference in how comfortable I feel day to day. I went on a weekend trip recently and realized I hadn't spent the whole time worrying about my stomach. That meant more to me than I can explain.

settings.question: Who should not take these drops?
settings.answer:
Talk to your doctor first if you:

  • are pregnant, nursing or trying to get pregnant
  • are under 18
  • take blood thinners or any prescription medicine
  • have seizures, or a liver, kidney or gallbladder condition
  • are allergic to ragweed or daisies (wormwood is in that plant family)

These drops are for everyday gut support.*
